name: How do I choose the right weatherproofing materials for my windows?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right weatherproofing materials for my windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right weatherproofing materials depends on your window type, the specific gaps or areas needing sealing, and desired durability. For stationary gaps, silicone or acrylic latex caulk are common. Silicone offers flexibility and durability for outdoor use, while acrylic latex is paintable and easy to clean. For moving window parts, various types of weatherstripping exist, such as foam, V-strip, or tension seals, each suited for different gaps and friction levels. A professional can assess your windows and recommend the most effective and long-lasting materials for your home's specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Material choice depends on window type and gap location. Silicone caulk is durable for stationary gaps, while various weatherstripping types suit moving parts. A professional can advise.
